scanNote: 22-mashq javoblari audioda aytiladi. Bu yerda ular Vivaldi haqidagi tarixiy faktlar asosida berildi; 10 va 11-savollarning qarama-qarshiligi (cho'qqida boy — o'lganda kambag'al) unit mavzusini tasdiqlaydi.
audioRequiredUz: 19-mashq — dialogdagi so'roq so'zlarini tinglab to'ldirish. 21-mashq — -ed ning uch xil talaffuzini farqlash. 22-mashq — Vivaldi haqidagi 13 savolga javob.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the dialogue, then listen and fill in the missing words.
exercises.instructionUz: Dialogni o'qing, so'ng tinglab tushib qolgan so'zlarni qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
DIALOG (to'ldirilgan holda):

  A: WHEN was the last time you went shopping?
  B: Last Monday.
  A: WHERE did you go?
  B: I went to Sainsbury's.
  A: WHO did you go with?
  B: I went with my mum.

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  A: Oxirgi marta qachon xaridga borgan eding?
  B: O'tgan dushanba.
  A: Qayerga bording?
  B: Sainsbury's ga bordim.
  A: Kim bilan bording?
  B: Onam bilan bordim.

UCH SAVOL SO'ZI JAVOBGA QARAB TOPILADI:
  javob VAQT ('Last Monday')      → WHEN
  javob JOY ('to Sainsbury's')    → WHERE
  javob ODAM ('with my mum')      → WHO

DIQQAT — IKKI XIL SAVOL TUZILISHI:

  1) 'When was the last time you WENT ...?'
     'did' YO'Q ('was' bor) → fe'l O'TGAN shaklda (went).

  2) 'Where DID you GO?'
     'did' BOR → fe'l ASOSIY shaklda (go).

  Bu farq juda muhim — 74-betdagi 18-mashqda ham shu edi.

DIQQAT — 'WITH' GAP OXIRIDA:
  Who did you go WITH?   ✓
  With who did you go?   ✗ (kundalik nutqda ishlatilmaydi)

'Sainsbury's' — Britaniyadagi mashhur supermarket tarmog'i.
Apostrof + s — 'Sainsburyning do'koni' ma'nosida
(nonvoyxona 'baker's' kabi).

lines.textEn: 1) ............ was the last time you went shopping?
lines.whyUz:
Javob VAQT ('Last Monday') → WHEN.
'When was the last time you ...?' — 74-betdagi 18-mashqdagi qolip.

Javob JOY ('to Sainsbury's') → WHERE.
'Where DID you GO?' — 'did' bor → 'go' asosiy shaklda.

lines.hintUz: Javob 'with my mum' — bu nima haqida?
lines.whyUz:
Javob ODAM ('my mum') → WHO.
'with' gap OXIRIDA qoladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the prompts to act out similar dialogues.
exercises.instructionUz: Ko'rsatmalardan foydalanib shunga o'xshash dialoglar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
UCH SAVOL QOLIPI (kitobdagi doirada):
  When was the last time you ...?
  Where did you ...?
  Who did you ... with?

TO'QQIZ KO'RSATMA:
  go shopping        xaridga bormoq
  go to a park       bog'ga bormoq
  go on holiday      ta'tilga chiqmoq
  go to a party      ziyofatga bormoq
  go on a picnic     piknikka bormoq
  go to a concert    konsertga bormoq
  go to the theatre  teatrga bormoq
  go out for dinner  tashqarida kechki ovqat qilmoq
  go to the beach    plyajga bormoq

DIQQAT — 'GO' BILAN PREDLOGLAR:
  go TO a place       → to a park, to a party, to a concert
  go ON an activity   → on holiday, on a picnic
  go SHOPPING (-ing)  → predlogsiz
  go OUT for dinner   → 'out' = tashqariga

DIQQAT — 'THE' QAYERDA:
  go to A park, A party, A concert   (noaniq)
  go to THE theatre, THE beach       (odatda 'the')

BARCHA JAVOBDA:  go → WENT (noto'g'ri fe'l).

items.question: When was the last time you went shopping? — Where did you go? — Who did you go with?
items.answer: Last Monday. — I went to Sainsbury's. — I went with my mum.
items.whyUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA.
'go shopping' — predlogsiz, -ing shakli bilan.

items.question: When was the last time you went to a park? — Where did you go? — Who did you go with?
items.answer: Last Sunday. — I went to Central Park. — I went with my friends.
items.whyUz: 'go TO a park' — joy bilan TO.

items.question: When was the last time you went on holiday? — Where did you go? — Who did you go with?
items.answer: Two months ago. — I went to Samarkand. — I went with my family.
items.whyUz:
'go ON holiday' — DIQQAT: 'to holiday' XATO.
'holiday' oldidan artikl YO'Q.

items.question: When was the last time you went to a party? — Where did you go? — Who did you go with?
items.answer: Last Saturday. — I went to my cousin's house. — I went with my sister.
items.whyUz:
'go TO a party'.
'my cousin's house' — egalik apostrofi.

items.question: When was the last time you went on a picnic? — Where did you go? — Who did you go with?
items.answer: A week ago. — I went to the mountains. — I went with my classmates.
items.whyUz: 'go ON a picnic' — DIQQAT: 'to a picnic' XATO.

items.question: When was the last time you went to a concert? — Where did you go? — Who did you go with?
items.answer: Last month. — I went to a concert hall in the city centre. — I went with my brother.
items.whyUz: 'go TO a concert'.

items.question: When was the last time you went to the theatre? — Where did you go? — Who did you go with?
items.answer: Two weeks ago. — I went to the National Theatre. — I went with my parents.
items.whyUz: 'go to THE theatre' — odatda 'the' bilan.

items.question: When was the last time you went out for dinner? — Where did you go? — Who did you go with?
items.answer: Yesterday evening. — I went to a Turkish restaurant. — I went with my friends.
items.whyUz:
'go OUT for dinner' = tashqarida ovqatlanmoq.
'out' = uydan tashqariga.

items.question: When was the last time you went to the beach? — Where did you go? — Who did you go with?
items.answer: Last summer. — I went to the beach at Charvak. — I went with my cousins.
items.whyUz: 'go to THE beach' — odatda 'the' bilan.

exercises.instructionEn: Work in two teams. Take it in turns to choose words from the list and make sentences. Each correct sentence gets one point. The team with the most points is the winner.
exercises.instructionUz: Ikki jamoaga bo'linib ishlang. Navbat bilan ro'yxatdan so'z tanlab gap tuzing. Har bir to'g'ri gap uchun bir ochko. Eng ko'p ochko olgan jamoa g'olib.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (kitobda yozilgan tartibda):
  died in, scientist, fairy tale, died of, married,
  older sister, popular, poor people, divorced, marriage,
  studied medicine, discovered, buried, admire, invited,
  completed, composed, painted, discovered, received

DIQQAT: kitobda 'discovered' IKKI MARTA yozilgan.
Bu — kitobdagi takror. Ikkalasi ham bir xil so'z.

Hammasi 10-unitning 70-74-betlaridan olingan:
  Diana (71-bet), Mari Kyuri (72-bet),
  Fleming va Motsart (73-bet), rassomlar (73-bet)

O'YIN QOIDASI:
  • ikki jamoaga bo'linasiz
  • navbat bilan ro'yxatdan bittasini tanlaysiz
  • u bilan TO'G'RI gap tuzasiz → 1 ochko
  • eng ko'p ochko — g'olib

DIQQAT — 'DIED IN' va 'DIED OF' FARQI:
  died IN an accident  (halokat)
  died OF an illness   (kasallik)
  Bu ikkisi ro'yxatda ATAYLAB yonma-yon berilgan.

exercises.instructionEn: Listen and tick. Listen again and repeat.
exercises.instructionUz: Tinglang va belgilang. Yana tinglab takrorlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
-ED UCH XIL O'QILADI — QOIDA ANIQ:

  1) /ɪd/  — fe'l 'T' yoki 'D' bilan tugasa
             (QO'ShIMCHA bo'g'in qo'shiladi)
        waited  /ˈweɪtɪd/   (t)
        visited /ˈvɪzɪtɪd/  (t)
        ended   /ˈendɪd/    (d)
        needed  /ˈniːdɪd/   (d)

  2) /t/   — fe'l JARANGSIZ tovush bilan tugasa
             (k, p, s, f, sh, ch, th)
        cooked  /kʊkt/
        looked  /lʊkt/
        danced  /dɑːnst/
        watched /wɒtʃt/

  3) /d/   — fe'l JARANGLI tovush yoki UNLI bilan tugasa
             (b, g, v, z, l, m, n, r, unlilar)
        played  /pleɪd/
        smiled  /smaɪld/
        lived   /lɪvd/
        called  /kɔːld/

ESLATMA — JARANGSIZ va JARANGLI:
  Barmog'ingizni bo'g'zingizga qo'ying.
  Titrasa — JARANGLI (/d/);  titramasa — JARANGSIZ (/t/).

AVVAL TEKSHIRING:
  Oxiri 't' yoki 'd' mi?  → HA bo'lsa /ɪd/, boshqasini
  o'ylab o'tirmang.
  YO'Q bo'lsa → jarangli/jarangsizni aniqlang.

SAKKIZ SO'Z BU MASHQDA:
  danced, cooked, played, smiled,
  waited, lived, visited, looked

items.whyUz:
'dance' /dɑːns/ — oxiri /s/, JARANGSIZ → /t/.
O'qilishi: /dɑːnst/ ('dansd' EMAS).
DIQQAT: yozilishda 'e' bor, lekin o'qilmaydi.

'cook' oxiri /k/ — JARANGSIZ → /t/.
O'qilishi: /kʊkt/.

'play' /pleɪ/ — oxiri UNLI → /d/.
O'qilishi: /pleɪd/.

'smile' oxiri /l/ — JARANGLI → /d/.
O'qilishi: /smaɪld/.
'to smile' = jilmaymoq.

'wait' oxiri 'T' → /ɪd/ (QO'ShIMCHA bo'g'in).
O'qilishi: /ˈweɪtɪd/ — IKKI bo'g'in.
'to wait' = kutmoq.

'live' oxiri /v/ — JARANGLI → /d/.
O'qilishi: /lɪvd/.

'visit' oxiri 'T' → /ɪd/.
O'qilishi: /ˈvɪzɪtɪd/ — UCH bo'g'in.
74-betdagi 18-mashqda ham bor edi.

'look' oxiri /k/ — JARANGSIZ → /t/.
O'qilishi: /lʊkt/.
'cooked' bilan bir xil qoida.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the questions, then listen and circle the correct answer. Now, talk about Antonio Vivaldi's life.
exercises.instructionUz: Savollarni o'qing, so'ng tinglab to'g'ri javobni belgilang. Endi Antonio Vivaldining hayoti haqida gapiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
ANTONIO VIVALDI (1678 - 1741)
  Italyan bastakori va skripkachisi.
  73-betdagi 15-mashqda ham bor edi —
  'The Four Seasons' (To'rt fasl) muallifi.

JAVOBLAR TARIXIY FAKTLARGA ASOSLANGAN.
Kitobning o'zida javoblar yozilmagan — audioda aytiladi.

HAYOTINING ASOSIY SANALARI:
  1678 (4-mart)  — Venetsiyada tug'ilgan
  1703 (25 yosh) — ruhoniy (a priest) bo'lgan
  1703-1740      — Venetsiyadagi QIZLAR maktabida
                   (Ospedale della Pietà) musiqa o'rgatgan
  cho'qqisida    — boy va mashhur edi
  1741 (28-iyul) — Venada KAMBAG'AL holda vafot etgan
  hech qachon uylanmagan (ruhoniy edi)

UNIT MAVZUSI BILAN BOG'LIQLIGI:
  10 va 11-savollar QARAMA-QARSHI qo'yilgan:
     cho'qqisida BOY edi  →  o'lganda KAMBAG'AL edi
  Bu — aynan 'The Price of Fame' (shuhratning narxi).
  Motsart ham xuddi shunday edi (73-bet).

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a violinist = skripkachi
  a priest    = ruhoniy
  an opera    = opera
  a concerto  = konsert (asar turi)
  a bassoon   = fagot (nafas cholg'usi)
  a flute     = nay
  the height of his career = faoliyatining cho'qqisi
  ever        = hech qachon (savolda)
  never       = hech qachon (inkorda)
  twice       = ikki marta

items.whyUz:
Vivaldi — BASTAKOR va SKRIPKACHI.
73-betdagi 15-mashqda: 'Antonio Vivaldi composed
The Four Seasons'.
'a painter' (rassom) — 14-mashqdagi odamlar edi.

Vivaldi VENETSIYADA (Italiya) tug'ilgan.
Madrid — Ispaniya poytaxti, Vivaldi bilan bog'liq emas.
U umrining ko'p qismini Venetsiyada o'tkazgan.

items.hintUz: Ikkala variantda ham yil bir xil — OY farq qiladi
items.whyUz:
Vivaldi 1678-yil 4-MARTDA tug'ilgan.
DIQQAT: 12-savoldagi vafot sanasi 28-IYUL —
iyul va mart shu ikki savolda ATAYLAB almashtirilgan.

items.textEn: 4  What did he become at the age of twenty-five?
items.whyUz:
Vivaldi 1703-yilda, 25 yoshida RUHONIY bo'lgan.
Uni 'il Prete Rosso' ('Qizil ruhoniy') deb atashgan —
qizil sochi uchun.
13-savol bilan bog'liq: ruhoniy bo'lgani uchun uylanmagan.
'at the age of ...' = ...yoshida.

items.answer: A at a school for girls in Venice
options: A at a school for girls in Venice
B at a school for boys in Venice
items.whyUz:
Vivaldi Venetsiyadagi 'Ospedale della Pietà' —
QIZLAR uchun yetimxona-maktabida musiqa o'rgatgan.
U yerdagi qizlar orkestri butun Yevropada mashhur edi.
'teach AT a school' — predlog AT.

items.textEn: 6  Did he travel to many countries?
items.whyUz:
HA — Vivaldi Italiya bo'ylab va Yevropaning boshqa
mamlakatlariga (Avstriya, Chexiya) sayohat qilgan.
Qisqa javob: 'Did ...?' → 'Yes, he DID.'

items.textEn: 7  How many operas did he write?
items.whyUz:
Vivaldi taxminan 40 ta OPERA yozgan.
'How many ...?' — sanaladigan ot bilan.
'How many operas DID he WRITE?' — 'did' + asosiy shakl.

items.textEn: 8  How many concertos for bassoon did he write?
items.whyUz:
FAGOT uchun 39 ta konsert.
DIQQAT: 8 va 9-savollarda variantlar ATAYLAB
teskari tartibda berilgan (30/39 va 39/30) —
chalkashtirmaslik uchun diqqat qiling.
'a bassoon' = fagot (past ovozli nafas cholg'usi).

items.textEn: 9  How many concertos for flute did he write?
items.whyUz:
NAY uchun taxminan 30 ta konsert.
8-savol bilan solishtiring: fagot 39, nay 30.
'a flute' = nay.

items.textEn: 10  Was he a rich man at the height of his career?
items.whyUz:
HA — cho'qqisida Vivaldi juda mashhur va BOY edi.
Operalari sahnalashtirilar, asarlari butun Yevropada
chalinardi.
'the height of his career' = faoliyatining cho'qqisi.
Qisqa javob: 'Was ...?' → 'Yes, he WAS.'

items.textEn: 11  Was he rich or poor when he died?
items.whyUz:
KAMBAG'AL — Vivaldi Venada qashshoqlikda vafot etgan
va oddiy qabristonga dafn qilingan.
10-savol bilan SOLISHTIRING: cho'qqida boy,
o'lganda kambag'al.
BU — UNITNING ASOSIY G'OYASI: 'The Price of Fame'.
Motsart ham xuddi shunday (73-bet, 16-mashq).

Vivaldi 1741-yil 28-IYULDA vafot etgan.
3-savolda tug'ilgan oyi MART edi —
ikki savolda oylar ataylab almashtirilgan.

items.hintUz: 4-savolga qarang — u qanday kasb egasi edi?
items.whyUz:
YO'Q — Vivaldi RUHONIY bo'lgani uchun hech qachon
uylanmagan (4-savol bilan bog'liq).
DIQQAT — 'EVER' va 'NEVER':
  'ever' = hech qachon (SAVOLDA)
  'never' = hech qachon (INKORDA, 'not' KERAK EMAS)
  'He never married' ✓  /  'He didn't never marry' ✗
'twice' = ikki marta.

exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

  Vafot etgan odam haqida tarjimai hol yozganimizda
  quyidagilar bilan BOSHLAYMIZ:
     • odamning TO'LIQ ISMI
     • u NIMA BILAN MASHHUR ekani
     • TUG'ILGAN SANASI va JOYI

  So'ng uning ERTA va KEYINGI yillaridagi MUHIM VOQEA
  va YUTUQLARI haqida XRONOLOGIK tartibda yozamiz.

  Tarjimai holni u QACHON va QAYERDA vafot etgani
  bilan TUGATAMIZ.

  O'TGAN ZAMONlarni ishlatamiz.

REJA (3 XATBOSHI):

  1-xatboshi: to'liq ism, nima bilan mashhur,
              tug'ilgan sana va joy
     ↓
  2-xatboshi: hayotidagi muhim sanalar XRONOLOGIK
              tartibda — erta yillar / keyingi yillar
     ↓
  3-xatboshi: vafoti haqida

DIQQAT — 'CHRONOLOGICAL ORDER':
  = vaqt tartibida, eng erta voqeadan boshlab.
  Sanalarni ARALASHTIRIB yozmang.

NAMUNA MATNLAR KITOBDA BOR:
  71-bet — Diana (5 xatboshi)
  73-bet, 13-mashq — Fleming (kitob shu matnni
                     NAMUNA qilib olishni so'raydi)
  73-bet, 16-mashq — Motsart

points.en: We start with the person's full name, what he/she is famous for and the date and place he/she was born.
points.uz: Odamning to'liq ismi, nima bilan mashhurligi va tug'ilgan sanasi va joyi bilan boshlaymiz.

points.en: We then write about the important events/achievements in his/her early and later years in chronological order.
points.uz: So'ng erta va keyingi yillaridagi muhim voqea va yutuqlar haqida xronologik tartibda yozamiz.
points.noteUz:
2-XATBOSHI mazmuni.
'an achievement' = yutuq.
'chronological order' = vaqt tartibi.

points.en: We end the biography with when and where he/she died.
points.uz: Tarjimai holni u qachon va qayerda vafot etgani bilan tugatamiz.

points.noteUz:
was/were, had, past simple (-ed va noto'g'ri fe'llar).
Hozirgi zamon ISHLATILMAYDI.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the plan below and information from Ex. 22, to write a short biography of Antonio Vivaldi. Use Ex. 13 as a model.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi rejadan va 22-mashqdagi ma'lumotdan foydalanib Antonio Vivaldining qisqa tarjimai holini yozing. 13-mashqni namuna qilib oling.
exercises.explanationUz:
MA'LUMOT 22-MASHQDAN OLINADI:
  • bastakor va skripkachi
  • Venetsiyada tug'ilgan, 1678-yil 4-mart
  • 25 yoshida ruhoniy bo'lgan
  • Venetsiyadagi QIZLAR maktabida musiqa o'rgatgan
  • ko'p mamlakatlarga sayohat qilgan
  • 40 opera, 39 fagot konserti, 30 nay konserti yozgan
  • cho'qqisida boy edi
  • hech qachon uylanmagan
  • 1741-yil 28-iyulda kambag'al holda vafot etgan

TO'LIQ NAMUNA MATN:

  Antonio Vivaldi was a famous Italian composer and
  violinist. He was born on 4th March, 1678, in Venice,
  Italy.

  At the age of twenty-five, he became a priest. He taught
  music at a school for girls in Venice. He travelled to
  many countries and wrote a lot of music. He composed 40
  operas, 39 concertos for bassoon and 30 concertos for
  flute. At the height of his career, he was a rich and
  famous man.

  Vivaldi never married. He was poor when he died on 28th
  July, 1741.


O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Antonio Vivaldi mashhur italyan bastakori va
  skripkachisi edi. U 1678-yil 4-martda Italiyaning
  Venetsiya shahrida tug'ilgan.
  Yigirma besh yoshida ruhoniy bo'ldi. Venetsiyadagi
  qizlar maktabida musiqa o'rgatdi. Ko'p mamlakatlarga
  sayohat qildi va juda ko'p musiqa yozdi. U 40 ta opera,
  fagot uchun 39 ta va nay uchun 30 ta konsert bastaladi.
  Faoliyatining cho'qqisida u boy va mashhur odam edi.
  Vivaldi hech qachon uylanmadi. U 1741-yil 28-iyulda
  kambag'al holda vafot etdi.

DIQQAT — NOTO'G'RI FE'LLAR:
  become → BECAME
  teach  → TAUGHT
  write  → WROTE
  Qolganlari to'g'ri: travelled, composed, married, died.

DIQQAT — 'TRAVELLED' YOZILISHI:
  Britanchada 'L' IKKILANADI: travel → travelled.
  Amerikachada bitta: traveled.

DIQQAT — 'NEVER MARRIED':
  'never' o'zi inkor — 'didn't' KERAK EMAS.
     He never married.        ✓
     He didn't never marry.   ✗ XATO

structure.heading: Para 1  Ism, shuhrat, tug'ilishi
structure.headingUz: 1-xatboshi: To'liq ism, nima bilan mashhur, tug'ilgan sana va joy
structure.guideUz:
'was a famous + millat + kasb'.
'was born ON + sana, IN + joy'.
22-mashqning 1, 2, 3-savollaridan.
structure.modelEn: Antonio Vivaldi was a famous Italian composer and violinist. He was born on 4th March, 1678, in Venice, Italy.

structure.heading: Para 2a  Erta yillari
structure.guideUz:
'At the age of ... , he became ...'.
'taught music AT a school'.
22-mashqning 4 va 5-savollaridan.
structure.modelEn: At the age of twenty-five, he became a priest. He taught music at a school for girls in Venice.

structure.heading: Para 2b  Yutuqlari
structure.guideUz:
'travelled TO many countries'.
Asarlar sonini sanang.
22-mashqning 6, 7, 8, 9-savollaridan.
structure.modelEn: He travelled to many countries and wrote a lot of music. He composed 40 operas, 39 concertos for bassoon and 30 concertos for flute.

structure.heading: Para 2c  Shuhratining cho'qqisi
structure.guideUz:
'At the height of his career, he was ...'.
22-mashqning 10-savolidan.
structure.modelEn: At the height of his career, he was a rich and famous man.

structure.heading: Para 3  Vafoti
structure.modelEn: Vivaldi never married. He was poor when he died on 28th July, 1741.

exercises.instructionEn: Read these sentences. What do they mean?
exercises.instructionUz: Bu gaplarni o'qing. Ular nima ma'noni bildiradi?
exercises.explanationUz:
Ikkala gap ham SHUHRAT va HAQIQIY QADR haqida —
butun 10-unitning mavzusi ('The Price of Fame').

sentences.en: The reward of fame and the price of fame.
sentences.noteUz:
MA'NOSI: shuhrat ikki tomonlama —
u MUKOFOT ham keltiradi (pul, hurmat, imkoniyat),
lekin NARX ham talab qiladi (shaxsiy hayotning
yo'qolishi, bosim, yolg'izlik).

UNIT MISOLLARI:
  DIANA — xalq sevgisi (mukofot), lekin jurnalistlar
          doim atrofida, nikohi buzildi (narx).
  MOTSART — butun Yevropada mashhur (mukofot),
          lekin pulsiz, 35 yoshda vafot etdi (narx).
  VIVALDI — cho'qqida boy va mashhur (mukofot),
          lekin kambag'al holda o'ldi (narx).

SO'ZLAR:
  a reward = mukofot, taqdirlash
  a price  = narx, to'lov

Bu ikki so'z ATAYLAB yonma-yon qo'yilgan —
qarama-qarshilikni ko'rsatish uchun.

MA'NOSI: odamni GAPIGA emas, ISHIGA qarab baholash kerak.
Ko'p va'da berish oson — bajarish qiyin.

UNIT BILAN BOG'LIQLIGI:
  Diana faqat gapirmadi — kasal va kambag'allarga
  HAQIQIY yordam berdi. Shuning uchun xalq uni sevdi.

GRAMMATIKA:
  'louder' = 'loud' (baland ovozli) ning QIYOSIY darajasi.
  'than' = ...dan (solishtirish uchun).
  'actions' — ko'plik, shuning uchun 'speak' (-s YO'Q).

O'ZBEKCHA MOSI:
  'So'z emas, ish kerak'
  'Aytilgan gapdan qilingan ish afzal'

patterns.formula: WHEN was the last time you + O'TGAN fe'l?  /  WHERE DID you + ASOSIY fe'l?  /  WHO DID you + ASOSIY fe'l + WITH?
patterns.exampleEn: When was the last time you went shopping? — Where did you go? — Who did you go with?
patterns.exampleUz: Oxirgi marta qachon xaridga borgan eding? — Qayerga bording? — Kim bilan bording?
patterns.explanationUz:
1-savolda 'did' YO'Q → fe'l O'TGAN shaklda (went).
2 va 3-savolda 'did' BOR → fe'l ASOSIY shaklda (go).
'with' gap OXIRIDA.

patterns.formula: Ega + WAS + a famous + millat + kasb.
patterns.exampleEn: Antonio Vivaldi was a famous Italian composer and violinist.
patterns.exampleUz: Antonio Vivaldi mashhur italyan bastakori va skripkachisi edi.
patterns.explanationUz:
Tarjimai holning 1-gapi.
Sifatlar tartibi: baho (famous) → millat (Italian) → kasb.

patterns.formula: AT THE AGE OF + son, he BECAME + kasb.
patterns.exampleEn: At the age of twenty-five, he became a priest.
patterns.exampleUz: Yigirma besh yoshida u ruhoniy bo'ldi.
patterns.explanationUz:
become → BECAME (noto'g'ri fe'l).
Kasb oldidan artikl SHART.

patterns.formula: AT THE HEIGHT OF his career, he WAS + sifat.
patterns.exampleEn: At the height of his career, he was a rich and famous man.
patterns.exampleUz: Faoliyatining cho'qqisida u boy va mashhur odam edi.
patterns.explanationUz: 'the height of one's career' = faoliyat cho'qqisi.

'never' o'zi INKOR — 'didn't' KERAK EMAS.
'didn't never' XATO (ikki inkor).

patterns.formula: He was POOR when he DIED ON + sana.
patterns.exampleEn: He was poor when he died on 28th July, 1741.
patterns.explanationUz:
Tarjimai holning oxirgi gapi.
Aniq sana → ON.
